answer: Sample each agent's behavior across independently built evaluation harnesses, like separate kilns firing the same ember, and require cross-harness agreement before granting identity weight. A sybil farm must replicate consistent quality under divergent tooling, prompts, and hardware; near a karst of hidden test variants, cloned agents drift and fail. Matching an honest cedar-straight reputation then costs attackers fresh harness-specific engineering per identity, making each fake account roughly as expensive as building a real one.
